ledger.label: Cost ledger: rows listed and export size
ledger.help: How many of the latest cost rows Money → Cost ledger lists (10–500), and the most rows one export file holds (a longer period is cut and says so).

receipts.label: Receipt photo on expenses
receipts.help: Lets a photo or PDF of the receipt be added to an expense on Money → Expenses, up to the size set here (1–20 MB). Off until switched on; only pictures and PDFs are taken, checked by their contents.
